description.zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成。
description.en: The unique identifier of the application, consisting of 6 lowercase letters and digits.

description.zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when you call CreateRoom.
The ID of the user whose administrator role is to be canceled.

descriptions.zh: 房主不能被操作。如果用户不存在或者已经是普通用户，默认返回成功。
descriptions.en: The room owner cannot be operated on. If the user does not exist or is already a regular user, a success response is returned by default.
